# Regulatory Signals

Live rules that change the competitive picture. These are dated and source-linked, and one of them is recent enough to post-date Phase 3A.

| Signal | Date | Change | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| **DPIIT Gazette Notification 108(E)** | 2026-02-04 | Startup recognition turnover threshold revised from ₹100 crore to ₹200 crore. | NEEDS VERIFICATION AGAINST THE GAZETTE ITSELF |
| **Startup India Seed Fund Scheme - incubator management fee** | Current | Management fee @ 5% of the seed grant provisioned to the incubator (₹1 crore grant = ₹1.05 crore total). | T1_DOCUMENT |
| **Startup Runway on GeM** | Current | Dedicated marketplace category for startups; 10,360+ startups registered, 74,935 orders fulfilled. | T1_DOCUMENT |

## Why each matters competitively

### DPIIT Gazette Notification 108(E)

- **Change.** Startup recognition turnover threshold revised from ₹100 crore to ₹200 crore.
- **Competitive implication.** Shrinks the DPIIT-recognised population. NIRF Innovation counts the 'startups recognised' figure, and Phase 7 uses 777 filers. A higher threshold means fewer recognitions, which feeds a 5-mark NIRF criterion.
- **Status.** NEEDS VERIFICATION AGAINST THE GAZETTE ITSELF
- **Source.** <https://www.startupindia.gov.in/content/sih/en/home-page.html>

### Startup India Seed Fund Scheme - incubator management fee

- **Change.** Management fee @ 5% of the seed grant provisioned to the incubator (₹1 crore grant = ₹1.05 crore total).
- **Competitive implication.** This is REAL money flowing to incubators through a system they must administer. It is the strongest documentary reason a grant ledger (GAP-05) exists.
- **Status.** T1_DOCUMENT
- **Source.** <https://seedfund.startupindia.gov.in/glossary>

### Startup Runway on GeM

- **Change.** Dedicated marketplace category for startups; 10,360+ startups registered, 74,935 orders fulfilled.
- **Competitive implication.** A distribution channel that competes with any direct procurement motion.
- **Status.** T1_DOCUMENT
- **Source.** <https://assets-bg.gem.gov.in/resources/upload/shared_doc/4th-annual-report_v1_gem_compressed_1749110509.pdf>

## The one to verify next

**DPIIT Gazette Notification 108(E)** raises the startup-recognition turnover threshold from ₹100 crore to ₹200 crore. Phase 3A measured the DPIIT-recognised population at 354 startups across 7 NIRF forms, and Phase 7 used 777 NIRF Innovation filers as the SAM anchor. A higher recognition threshold shrinks the recognised population, which feeds a countable NIRF criterion. **This should be checked against the Gazette itself before it is used in any model** — the citation here is the Startup India portal disclaimer, not the primary instrument.
